Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q2 2023 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of JPM.
We generated $12.7 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 87 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.

Could you quantify the FX headwind embedded in your guidance?
